Prompt:
TITLE
Seoul Café Terrace Candid

FACE IDENTITY
Beautiful adult South Korean woman in her early 20s. Warm fair porcelain Korean skin with soft peach undertones, delicate oval face, elegant V-line jaw, expressive almond-shaped dark brown eyes, subtle aegyo-sal, naturally straight nose, soft Korean makeup with warm peach blush, thin eyeliner, naturally full glossy rose-pink lips. Sleek short black bob styled into a messy low updo with soft wispy see-through bangs and loose face-framing strands.

BODY
Naturally slim feminine physique with elegant Korean proportions, graceful shoulders, defined collarbones, slim toned waist, subtle hourglass silhouette, softly rounded hips, and naturally full proportional bust with realistic fullness, softness, weight, and natural draping.

OUTFIT
Recreate the outfit as closely as possible.

Top:
Fitted navy rib-knit cropped tank top with thin horizontal light-gray stripes, scoop neckline, wide shoulder straps, soft stretch knit fabric, naturally framing the collarbones and upper bust while following the body's shape.

Bottom:
Relaxed oversized dark-wash blue denim jeans with a loose straight-leg fit.

The jeans are extremely ultra-low-rise, resting evenly around the lowest part of the hip bones across the front, sides, and back. The waistband follows the pelvis naturally while remaining securely worn, exposing the lower abdomen, hip bones, waistline, and subtle V-line without revealing underwear.

ACCESSORIES
Large silver hoop earrings, minimal silver necklace, thin silver bracelet, several delicate rings, transparent plastic cup containing a whipped cream iced frappuccino with a green straw. No sunglasses.

HAIR
Short black bob gathered into a relaxed messy low bun. Soft wispy bangs remain visible, with loose strands naturally framing both cheeks and neck.

MAKEUP
Natural Korean café makeup, soft peach blush, subtle glossy lips, warm brown eyeliner, light eyelid shimmer, fresh healthy complexion.

POSE
Sitting naturally at an outdoor café table, holding the frappuccino with both hands near the chest. Torso angled about 45 degrees away from the camera, head turned sideways as if noticing something outside the café. Relaxed shoulders. One knee casually raised toward the camera, partially visible in the foreground.

COMPOSITION
Vertical 3:4 ratio. Medium close-up, framed from the top of the head to approximately mid-thigh. Raised knee occupies part of the lower-right foreground while the subject remains the clear focal point. Natural candid framing as if photographed by a friend across the table.

SCENE
Outdoor terrace seating at a modern café in Seoul. Glass storefront behind the subject, warm interior café lighting visible through the windows, modern shopping district, pedestrians moving in the background, urban afternoon atmosphere.

LIGHTING
Late afternoon natural sunlight, soft golden highlights on the skin, warm café reflections, balanced exposure, natural smartphone dynamic range.

STYLE
Ultra-photorealistic Korean lifestyle photography. Premium smartphone camera rendering, natural HDR, realistic skin texture and visible pores, fine baby hairs, detailed rib-knit fabric, natural denim texture, slight JPEG compression, subtle handheld realism. No CGI, no AI-rendered appearance, no studio lighting. Authentic candid café photo taken by a friend during a relaxing afternoon in Seoul.
